markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: **请人做事**用 Can you / Could you …?；**问自己能不能做**用 Can I / Could I …?；**主动帮忙**用 Shall I …? 或 I'll …。越客气，句子就越长、越绕。

uses.en_zh: 我可以加入这个通话吗？

ask.title: 请别人做事
ask.text: 像楼梯一样一级比一级客气：**Can you** 随便，**Could you / Would you** 客气，加上 please 更好。后面都跟动词原形。

examples.en: [[Could you]] ((review)) my pull request <<when you have a minute>>?
examples.zh: 你有空的时候能帮我看看这个 PR 吗？

examples.en: [[Would you]] ((give)) me a hand with this, please?

notes: 答应别人：Sure. / Of course. / No problem.
拒绝要先道歉：Sorry, I can't right now — I'm in a meeting.

mind.title: Would you mind …?
mind.text: mind 是「介意」。后面的动词要加 **-ing**。小心回答：别人问「你介意吗」，**同意**要说 **No / Not at all**（不介意）。

examples.answer: Not at all. / No, of course not.

examples.en: [[Would you mind not using]] your phone here?
examples.zh: 麻烦你在这儿别用手机，好吗？

examples.en: [[Do you mind if I]] ((open)) the window?

wrong.bad: Would you mind ~~to send~~ it again?

mind.tip: 回答 Yes 等于说「我介意」，就是不答应。

permission.title: 我可以……吗
permission.text: 问自己能不能做一件事：**Can I** 随便，**Could I** 客气，**May I** 最正式。也可以说 **Do you mind if I …?**

examples.en: [[Could I]] ((have)) a glass of water, please?

offer.title: 主动帮忙
offer.text: 想帮别人一把，有好几种说法。**Shall I …?** 是问「要我……吗」；**I'll …** 是当场决定「我来」。

items.rule: 问对方要不要：Do you want me to …?

commonMistakes.why: want 后面说 me to do。
let me 后面直接跟原形。

commonMistakes.good: — Would you mind waiting? — [[Not at all.]]
commonMistakes.why: 答 Yes 是「我介意」，同意要说 Not at all。

quiz.prompt: You see your colleague carrying lots of boxes. You say: "___ help you?"

options: Can you send me the file?
Could you send me the file, please?
quiz.answer: Could you send me the file, please?

traps.note: mind 后面用 -ing，不用 to do。

quiz.prompt: — Would you mind waiting a minute? — ___ (你愿意等)
quiz.explain: 不介意才是答应：[[Not at all.]]

quiz.prompt: 改错：Would you mind to close the window?
quiz.answer: Would you mind closing the window?

quiz.prompt: On the phone at work: "___ ask who's calling?"
quiz.explain: 正式场合问自己可不可以：[[May I]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我可以加入这个通话吗？
改错：Do you want that I call him?
quiz.answer: Do you want me to call him?
quiz.explain: 说成 [[Do you want me to]] ((call)) him?

quiz.prompt: 改错：Let me to check the logs.
The phone is ringing. "Don't worry, ___ get it."
用 Would you like 主动请同事喝咖啡。
accept: Would you like a cup of coffee?

quiz.prompt: You want your colleague to open the window. You say: "___ open the window?"
quiz.explain: 让对方做用 [[Could you]]；Shall I 是我来做。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Shall I to book a meeting room?
quiz.answer: Shall I book a meeting room?

quiz.prompt: 翻译：你介意我开一下窗吗？
quiz.answer: Do you mind if I open the window?
accept: Would you mind if I opened the window?
Do you mind if I open the window a bit?
Would you mind if I open the window?
quiz.explain: 问自己能不能做：[[Do you mind if I]] ((open)) …？

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话：客气地请同事帮你做一件事；用 Would you mind … 再请一件事；最后主动提出帮别人做一件事。
rules: Can / Could / Would you、Shall I、Let me 后面用动词原形
Would you mind 后面用 -ing；Do you want me to + 原形
openTask.note: 规则判情态动词后的原形和 mind + -ing（计分）；离线模型给更自然、更客气的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
